Chapter 846: Chapter 35 Majestic Chaos (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 846: Chapter 35 Majestic Chaos (Subscription Request)_2

“Striving for the ultimate, life is striving for the ultimate.”

“To strive for the ultimate, one must at least grasp the Fifth Realm of Fusion of Time and Space.”

“Striving for the ultimate… I wonder if I can reach the threshold of striving for the ultimate before my lifespan ends.”

Since the birth of the universe, every long period of time, there have been lives attempting to strive for the ultimate, but the vast majority have failed, making many Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers quite familiar with this fluctuation.

…

“Is the source within the human civilization’s territory?”

In the heartland of the Insect Race, one Queen after another opens their eyes, looking towards the origin of the Chaos Void Origin.

“Is human civilization likely to give birth to the tenth ultimate being?”

The brows of many Insect Queens furrow deeply; human civilization is already strong enough. The birth of a tenth ultimate being now would likely leave the Insect Race struggling to breathe.

…

Tianyu Clan’s territory.

The ancestors all had serious expressions. Normally, Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers from human civilization, without certain assurance, would not be allowed to strive for the ultimate.

After all, once failed, it means the complete loss of this Eleventh Level Perfected Evolver.

The death caused by failing to strive for the ultimate can’t be reversed, as the life imprint would briefly shift out of the river of time. Success means completely freeing oneself from the binds of the river of time.

In case of failure, all traces will be erased.

Even the ultimate beings cannot be resurrected, lacking the life imprint as a ‘marker’, ultimate beings can’t find the target even if they go against the flow.

So.

For any peak racial power.

Striving for the ultimate is a matter taken with extreme caution.

Unless absolutely necessary, they would rather slow down their own time flow and drag it out than rashly strive for the ultimate.

Of course, those unique lives that are unaffiliated and unbound by clans are exceptions; some special beings, having lived long enough, will still forcefully strive for the ultimate even without certainty.

…

Milky Way Star Region.

Deep within the multiple Spatial Layers.

Lin Yuan sits cross-legged.

After releasing the suppression on himself.

He could clearly feel the universe momentarily plunging into a kind of silence.

Following that.

A terrifying cosmic spatial rift was torn open above his head.

The aura of the Chaos Void Origin descends, an invisible pressure begins to spread throughout the entire universe.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan looks upwards, the terrifying cosmic spatial rift continues to expand, in just an instant it spans more than ten light-years, the profound and mysterious aura of the Chaos Void rushes towards him.

“Is that the location of the Chaos Void Origin?” Lin Yuan looks at the space above, watching the rapidly inflating cosmic spatial rift that expanded to dozens of light-years outside, faintly revealing an enormous boundless space, carrying infinite might, supremely paramount.

Chaos Void Origin Infusion, the source naturally being the Chaos Void Origin, during the crossing of major life realms, a temporary connection to the Chaos Void Origin is formed to infuse the origin.

The cosmic space continues to be torn apart, finally stopping slowly when reaching one hundred light-years.

“One hundred light-years?” Lin Yuan immediately understands that this should be the limit of the Chaos Void Origin Infusion he can withstand this time.

Compared to the ten light-year rift when breaking through from Ninth Level to Tenth Level, the current one hundred light-year rift seems only ten times different, but the amount of the infused Chaos Void Origin in the end is far more than a hundred or a thousand times more.

“The Origin begins to infuse.”

The moment the cosmic space rift stops, Lin Yuan realizes that what he is about to face is the infusion of the Chaos Void Origin.

Whether it’s the infusion of the cosmic origin or the Chaos Void Origin, it is according to the life’s own comprehensive conditions.

Such as physical strength, soul strength, internal world strength, and so forth.

The higher the foundation, the larger the rift that can be opened, and the more origin it can withstand.

Among them, striving for the ultimate at Eleventh Level, life undergoing the ultimate transformation jump, the induced Chaos Void Origin Infusion, will far exceed the breakthrough from Tenth Level to Eleventh Level.

“Only three hundred thirty-three seconds, during this period I must endure as much Chaos Void Origin as possible.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

This opportunity, for nearly all beings within the universe, only comes once, and that is the assault on the ultimate at Level Eleven.

Even if one smoothly transitions to Level Twelve afterward, transforming the internal world into an internal universe, one can only slowly absorb the Chaos Void Origin.

Like now, absorbing recklessly without limits within three hundred and thirty-three seconds, this will never happen again.

…

Splash.

Across hundreds of light-years, within the cosmic rift, a profound and mysterious passageway to the lands of Chaos Void Origin immediately begins to pour out torrential Chaos Void Origin.

Boom– like the collapse of an ocean, the speed of the Primordial pour is terrifyingly fast, filling the entire hundred light-years with pure Chaos Void Origin Power.

“Absorb it all!”

Lin Yuan’s physical body wildly absorbs, his soul is also wildly absorbing, and his internal world is likewise wildly absorbing.

The Chaos Void Origin Power is extremely pure, almost needless of any refinement, as long as it is absorbed into the body, it can quickly transform into one’s own energy, and then push the foundation to increase.

“Hmm?”

Just twenty seconds later, Lin Yuan feels a ‘satiated sensation’ in his internal world, it’s clear that it has devoured enough.

“Continue absorbing.” Lin Yuan doesn’t stop, at this moment his internal world gives him a certain critical sensation, as if stepping further will break some kind of shackles.

…

Milky Way Star Region.

Humanity’s nine ultimate beings are somewhat stunned as they watch the cosmic space rift spanning hundreds of light-years and the endless Chaos Void Origin gushing into the depths of the spatial layers.

“A hundred light-years of space rift, it’s not much different from assaulting the ultimate at Level Eleven, right?” A Void God Ultimate Being is somewhat dazed.

Assaulting the ultimate at Level Eleven is not something unusual for the ultimate beings.

But Lin Yuan is not assaulting the ultimate, he’s assaulting Level Eleven.

Right now, the only difference between Lin Yuan and those assaulting the ultimate, is that he has not yet stepped out of the river of time, never undergoing the ultimate transformation.

“This…”

Xia Qin Ultimate Being is also frightened.

Before Lin Yuan’s assault on Level Eleven, he had predicted that the commotion would certainly not be small, especially since the scene during his previous Level Ten assault was placed there.

However, even so, Xia Qin Ultimate Being only dared to guess that Lin Yuan’s final assault commotion would merely be close to assaulting the assault; could it really be as thorough as it is now?

Level Eleven Assault on the Ultimate, life undergoing the ultimate transformation, can cause infusion of Chaos Void Origin that surpasses one’s own foundation.

Lin Yuan hasn’t undergone the ultimate transformation, yet he managed to evoke a disturbance no weaker than assaulting the ultimate, how is this possible?

Humanity’s nine ultimate beings stand in the void, continuously observing that hundreds of light-years rift, constantly pouring out Chaos Void Origin.

All the Origin is marked with the life imprint of Lin Yuan, even if it couldn’t be absorbed, it would rapidly disperse.

…

Compared to the shock of humanity’s nine ultimate beings.

The ultimate beings of the various peak clans within the cosmic starry skies, and ultimate existences, are somewhat uneasy.

Especially the Insect Race, Tianyu Clan and other forces completely hostile to human civilization, absolutely do not wish to see humanity’s civilization gain a tenth ultimate being.

If human civilization were to give birth to a tenth ultimate being, it would have profound impacts on the subsequent war situations, especially with the imminent opening of super-large battlefields.

“What do we do now?”

“Stop him? During the period of assaulting the ultimate, although one needs to withstand the backlash of the river of time, one is also under the protection of the river of time, and we, even after freeing ourselves from the constraints of the river of time, are far from being able to shake the river of time.”

“So what do we do? Just watch as humanity gains another ultimate being?”

Insect Race, Tianyu Clan, and many other ultimate beings quickly communicate.

“Head to the river of time.”

Insect Queen speaks up.

“Yes, the river of time.”

Hearing this, the other ultimate beings immediately nod.

Heading to the river of time, standing by the shore, although not able to observe the many details within the river of time.

But if there are beings successfully freeing themselves from the constraints of the river of time, stepping into Level Twelve, and emerging from the river onto the shore, they could still observe.
